title: Meeting someone new in English: phrases, conversation, speaking | English Routine
description:
Meeting someone new — التعارف على حد جديد
A full lesson for everyday American English, with Arabic help: 8 words and phrases, a real conversation, 3 listening questions, then your turn to speak.
درس كامل: ٨ كلمات بمعناها بالعربي، الحوار، ٣ أسئلة، وبعدين دورك تتكلم بصوتك.

Chapters
0:00 8 words
0:45 The conversation
1:29 3 questions
1:55 Your turn: speak
3:03 Good to know

Words
• I don't think we've met = أظن ماتقابلناش قبل كده
• originally = أصلًا (أصلي من…)
• what do you do? = بتشتغل إيه؟
• for a living = شغلانته / أكل عيشه
• introduce = يعرّف (حد بحد)
• get to know = يتعرف على
• I've heard a lot about you = سمعت عنك كتير
• keep in touch = نفضل على تواصل

Practice this situation in the app (it plays the other person and shows you what to fix), one of 665 real-life situations, A1 to C2:
